content.guidelines:
Cut 15-60 second clips from the reference videos and cards. Your own voice-over or captions are welcome.
Say the product name exactly: "Futures without liquidation" (leveraged crypto futures with no liquidation price, so a wick can't close the trade).
Hook idea: show the red liquidation line on a normal perp, then the same trade without it.
Put the campaign link in your bio (or your own ClickOptions referral link if you have one: you then also earn commission on the traders you bring).
Post in your audience's language.  English, Hindi, Vietnamese, Turkish, Indonesian, Portuguese, Spanish. Chinese. and others)  
"Guaranteed" may only be used about the absence of liquidation ("no liquidation, guaranteed"). Never use it about profits, returns or results, and never put it next to a profit number.
Never say "risk-free", "can't lose" or "you only lose what you put in". Positions can still lose money.
No profit promises. Show test results (like the 801-trade study) only with their label: past results from a backtest, not a forecast.
Don't change the numbers in our videos or present dated comparisons as today's prices.
No tokens, airdrops or giveaways.
Do not name any market maker or partner company.
No casino, gambling or memecoin pages.
Botted or bought views mean rejection and a permanent ban.
